table.common.clockStartsRun: The clock starts when you press Run. If the time runs out, BEEP winds time back and you try again.
table.common.forCap: Python needs the word "for" to be in small letters.
table.common.forIndent: The for line should not be pushed in. Start it at the left, with no spaces before it.
table.common.spaces: Push that line in by exactly 4 spaces. Press the Tab key to make them.
table.ch1.j.capF: Python needs the word "forward" to be in small letters.
table.ch1.j.fwdN: forward({n}) misses the next print. Each print is 10 metres on, so type forward(10).
table.ch1.j.capL: Python needs the word "look" to be in small letters.
table.ch1.fast[1]: If you had typed more slowly, the snow would have buried the trail.
table.ch1.lesson[0]: Look at this. You needed forward(10) and then look(), again and again, twenty times.

table.ch1.lesson[4]: Your two lines go under the for line. Push them in by four spaces.
table.ch1.h4: Type these 3 lines. Where you see 4 dots, type 4 spaces instead.

table.ch2.close[0].under[0]: You counted 4, 6 and 3 walls. The loop flew 4 times, then 6 times, then 3 times.
